chapter: Chris Kelly and the dance halls
title: Chris Kelly's band and why the banjo was never cut
summary: After Carey he played with Chris Kelly and a few times with Kid Rene; Kelly's band had clarinet, trumpet and Chester on bass, and a seven-piece band was standard, always with banjo.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
